digest.component_or_area: test design guidance and convergence test pattern
propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive oracle behavior instead of driving and capturing the real call site remain green when the underlying send path drifts, defeating their purpose.
The concrete defect (stale truncate_comment_body model in outbound_comment_length_convergence test) was fixed by commit 103729e90c to capture --body from real acli_cli_ops.add_comment call.

A mechanical lint rule to detect re-derived oracles cannot be implemented reliably because the defective pattern (both sides call shared fit helpers) is syntactically identical to sanctioned characterization tests.

The rule that convergence test oracles must capture external effects from real call sites, not recompute via helpers, must be recorded as authoring guidance in the shared test-design standard document.
The byte-identical sync of test-design.md canonical copy across all per-skill directories must be enforced by the existing test_skill_shared_sync.py gating test.
